items.title: Bob Watts Interview, 1963-02-28
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Oh, yeah, Peter Hunter, wouldn't let him touch it. [INTERVIEWEE] He's the one who bought that Octolang book. He bought me that first before they sent me the horn.

ctx.x: And we kept it going. But them fellas, I couldn't play nothing.
No. I couldn't play Peter Hunter. I told you that.
